body.p: In the In content tab, enter the text you want to search for in the search field at the top of the page. The search looks for matches in the text of project files. See for advanced options. A short reference is also available in the UI via the help icon next to the search field.
You can click on a result to open that file in the visual editor. For each found file you have additional actions to insert a link or a related link to it in the current opened document.
